title: 第1033章 你当个人吧第1032章 同境一招都接不住
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
所向无前，天下莫当其锋。
沈云展现出的战力，堪称震古烁今，放眼诸天亿万世界，能与之并肩者也寥寥无几。
“难道说...真是一尊窥真巨头崛起了？”
断壁残垣间，万烬生仰望着那道高悬苍穹的身影，心中的敬畏油然而生。
先前绝空出世时的恐怖，他至今还历历在目，八口空间混洞一出，无疑是货真价实的大罗巅峰。
然而在沈云面前，他连随手一击都难以招架，这等惊天动地的修为，已稳稳踏入窥真巨头的无上领域。
....
“逃，必须逃！”
仅剩残魂的千瞳鬼仙，已被彻底吓破了胆，再不敢有半分侥幸。
他万万没想到，当年那个下界的金丹蝼蚁，如今竟已臻至这等通天境界，简直是匪夷所思。
没有半分迟疑，鬼仙当即运转搏命秘术，身形化作一道刺目血光，撕裂虚空，亡命遁逃。
“好快！”
苍昊双目一凝，将速度提升至极致，整个人宛若天雷破空，却仍追不上那道血光的踪迹。
神念本就快过肉身，加上鬼仙施展了禁术，速度更是暴涨数倍，一息便跨越了数亿里之遥！
可惜，沈云的神念早已笼罩全场，瞬间便捕捉到了他的动向。
唰！
下一刻，时间法则奔涌而出，化作遮天巨手，朝着天际深处悍然探去。
“不！
！”
千瞳鬼仙目眦欲裂，被时间法则锁定的刹那，速度骤然暴跌千百倍！

远远望去，在那遮天蔽日的大手面前，他就像一只渺小的飞虫，无论如何挣扎，都逃不出这五指神山。
天旋地转间，千瞳鬼仙的残魂急剧收缩，被生生拽回，落入沈云掌心之中。
“如此深重的业力....若让你这么一死了之，未免太便宜你了。”
沈云漠然开口，似是感知到了什么，掌心猛地一翻。
砰——
千瞳鬼仙眼冒金星，身子骨差点被抖散架，一只只邪恶复眼接连炸裂！
刹那间，无数道虚幻身影自眼中喷薄而出，人影幢幢，粗略一数竟不下百万之众。
须知先前为唤醒绝空，鬼仙已燃烧了超过九成残魂，难以想象他究竟残害了多少生灵，当真是罪恶滔天、罄竹难书！
“这是哪里？”
这些冤魂刚被释放，神色还有些茫然。
待视线扫过四周，逐渐明白当下处境，当即齐齐向沈云躬身叩首。
“多谢上仙大恩，救我等脱离苦海！”
漫长岁月中，他们被鬼仙强行奴役，日夜承受灵魂撕裂之痛，生不如死。
如今终得解脱，面对这位救命恩人，心中唯有最纯粹的感激与敬意。
“不必多礼，我只是恰逢其会。”
沈云目光一扫，发现这群受害者大多三魂已失，即便今日脱离鬼仙掌控，也难逃魂飞魄散的下场。
content_en:
No one in the world can take the lead in moving forward.
The fighting prowess Chen Yun displayed was astonishing in the past and today. Looking at the billions of worlds in the sky, there are only a few people who can stand shoulder to shoulder with him.
"Could it be that... a real giant has risen?"
Among the ruins of the broken wall, Wan Jinsheng looked up at the figure hanging high in the sky, feeling awe in his heart.
He still vividly remembers the horror when Juekong was born before. When the eight-hole space hole comes out, he is undoubtedly the real pinnacle of Da Luo.
However, in front of Shen Yun, he could not even parry a casual blow. With such earth-shattering cultivation, he had firmly entered the supreme realm of the peeping giant.
....
"Escape, you must escape!"
The Thousand-Eyed Ghost Immortal, who only had a remnant soul, was completely frightened and did not dare to have any luck.
He never expected that the golden elixir ant in the lower realm would now reach such a heaven-reaching realm, which was simply unbelievable.
Without a moment's hesitation, the ghost immortal immediately activated his secret technique of fighting for his life, and his body turned into a dazzling bloody light, tearing the void, and fled for his life.
"So fast!"
Cang Hao's eyes were focused, and he increased his speed to the extreme. His whole body was like thunder piercing the sky, but he still couldn't follow the trail of blood.
The spiritual thoughts are already faster than the physical body, and with the forbidden technique cast by the ghost immortal, the speed increases several times, and one breath can cover hundreds of millions of miles!
Unfortunately, Chen Yun's spiritual thoughts had already enveloped the entire audience and captured his movements in an instant.
Uh-huh!
The next moment, the Law of Time rushed out, turned into a giant hand that covered the sky, and boldly reached into the depths of the sky.
"No!
! "
The eyes of the Thousand-Eyed Ghost Immortal were about to burst, and the moment they were locked by the law of time, their speed suddenly plummeted a thousand times!
Looking from a distance, in front of the big hand that covers the sky and the sun, he is like a tiny flying insect. No matter how hard he struggles, he can't escape from the five-finger mountain.
As the world spun, the remnant soul of the Thousand-Eyed Ghost Fairy shrank sharply, was pulled back, and fell into Chen Yun's palm.
"Such a heavy karma... It would be too easy for you to let you die like this."
Chen Yun spoke indifferently, as if sensing something, he suddenly turned his palms.
Bang——
The Thousand-Eyed Ghost Fairy's eyes were filled with stars, his body was almost shaken to pieces, and his evil compound eyes exploded one after another!
In an instant, countless illusory figures spurted out of his eyes, and there were numerous figures, and a rough count of them numbered no less than a million.
It should be noted that in order to awaken Jue Kong, Guixian had burned more than 90% of the remaining souls. It is hard to imagine how many living beings he had killed. His crimes were truly too heinous to describe!
"Where is this?"
These innocent souls had just been released, and they still looked a little confused.
After their eyes swept around, they gradually understood the current situation, and they all bowed and kowtowed to Chen Yun.
"Thank you so much for your great kindness, God, for saving us from the sea of misery!"
For a long time, they were forcibly enslaved by ghosts and immortals, suffering the pain of soul tearing day and night, making life worse than death.
Now that I am finally free, facing this lifesaver, I have only the purest gratitude and respect in my heart.
"No need to be polite, I just happened to meet you at the right time."
Chen Yun glanced around and found that most of these victims had lost their souls. Even if they escaped the control of the ghosts and immortals today, they would still be in ruins.
